Thanks Katie — couple of product clarifications to make sure the uplift doesn't introduce quality regressions during the pilot:

1) Model & variant: please confirm if you're targeting 'redwood-chat-3' (conversation streaming) or 'rwd-text-2' (batch short prompts). Streaming has higher concurrent token windows which matters for sustained QPS.

2) Session pattern: are these single-turn requests (stateless) or multi-turn sessions that keep KV cache warm? If multi-turn, what's average context length (tokens) per session?

3) Feature flags: will you enable sampling/temperature changes between pilot and production? We prefer consistent sampling to keep evals comparable.

Acceptance criteria for product sign-off: no model timeout > 5s P95 during the test window; end-to-end error rate < 1.5%. We'll run a short simulated load test on Apr 20 morning and provide traces.

Also: please upload the prompt-set used for quality checks to the Drive folder so we can add it to the regression harness.

- Marissa

Thanks for the model, Katie — I ran a quick capacity projection against our US-east pool. Notes: 

- Baseline 40 QPS: negligible impact.
- Peak sustained 220 QPS (90m): this will push the hosting pool towards a short-term saturation point: projected P95 latency bump to ~1.8x normal if we keep current batching.
- Sustained 80 QPS (6h): should be fine with current pool but needs careful KV cache warming.

Recommended temporary quota uplift request (approved via ops):
- Rate limit increase to allow 250 concurrent QPS for the Apr 20 08:00–Apr 25 23:59 window (regional, us-east).
- Soft-fallback policy: route to 'rwd-text-2' (lower-cost variant) when token spend > threshold (we'll configure automatic fallback).

Operational asks from PineHealth to proceed:
1) Submit the formal uplift request in HubSpot (link below) with the exact endpoints and IPs.
2) Agree to a short cost-coverage addendum for excess tokens during the pilot (finance will follow-up).
3) Allow Redwood infra team to run a scripted load test on Apr 20 07:00–08:00 to warm caches.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_quota_request_template.pdf (application/pdf)]

I'll open the internal ops ticket once we get the HubSpot record + signed addendum. If we need a faster path, we can spin a temporary capacity patch but that'll require approval from capacity on-call.

- Dylan
